question: Some people are sitting in a row facing north. Y is sitting fourth to the right of A. Only four people are sitting between Y and Z. B is sitting second to the left of Z. Only one person is sitting between Z and C. X is sitting immediately next to the right of C. X is sitting at one of the ends of the row. If no other person is sitting in the row, then what is the total number of people sitting in the row?
solution:
Given: Some people are sitting in a row facing north.

1) Y is sitting fourth to the right of A.

2) Only four people are sitting between Y and Z.

3) B is sitting second to the left of Z.

4) Only one person is sitting between Z and C.

5) X is sitting immediately next to the right of C.

6) X is sitting at one of the ends of the row.

Thus, the final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7189978942fdc0fbdcd6645f836f5d3faa950d95f592377aa1afaceb77aedcca.png] 

If no other person is sitting in the row, then **13** is the total number of people sitting in the row.

Hence, the correct answer is** "13".**
